cases.title: Add a single note and verify DOM elements
cases.description: Clicking the Add note button creates a new div element with class 'note' appended to the body, containing a visible, empty textarea with data-testid='note-textarea'.

cases.title: Rapid multiple clicks on Add note button
cases.description: Clicking the Add note button multiple times rapidly successfully creates a separate note with its own textarea for each click.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown rendering
cases.description: Typing valid Markdown into the note textarea dynamically renders formatted HTML in the note-main display area and updates local storage in real time.

cases.title: Invalid Markdown handling without crashing
cases.description: Entering invalid Markdown like unmatched asterisks does not crash the application, and exiting edit mode via the Edit button safely displays the raw input.

cases.title: Initial creation state and mode switching
cases.description: A newly created note starts in edit mode with the textarea visible and note-main hidden. Clicking the Edit button toggles between view and edit modes correctly.

cases.title: Delete note from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Clicking the Delete button on a note immediately removes the note element from the DOM and removes the corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Load saved notes from localStorage on page load
cases.description: When the page loads, notes stored in localStorage are retrieved using the 'notes' key. Populated notes show the main div with the textarea hidden, while empty notes show the textarea with the main div hidden.

cases.title: Empty localStorage initialization
cases.description: When the page loads and localStorage is empty, no notes are displayed on the page.

opinions.feedback: All test cases are well-structured, distinct, and directly testable against the provided requirements.
All requirements and test cases are well-defined, consistent, and fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior includes clicking the 'Add note' button (id="add", class="add", data-testid="add-note-button") to create a new <div> element appended to document body with class "note" containing an empty visible <textarea> (data-testid="note-textarea"). Boundaries include rapid multiple clicks creating multiple distinct notes. Normal path: single click creates one note. Abnormal/edge path: rapid successive clicks. Ambiguities: exact structure of tool buttons created simultaneously is clarified in R-5. R-2: Testable behavior involves editing notes with Markdown rendering. Inputs: standard Markdown (#, **, _, [link]). Outputs: dynamic real-time rendering in (data-testid="note-main"), raw input fallback on invalid Markdown (unmatched **) when exiting edit mode via 'Edit' button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), and state saved to localStorage. Normal path: valid Markdown renders to HTML. Abnormal path: invalid Markdown does not crash and falls back to raw text. Ambiguities: none. R-3: Testable behavior covers creation, view, and edit mode toggles. Normal path: clicking 'Add note' loads note in edit mode (textarea visible, note-main hidden). Clicking 'Edit' toggles view mode (note-main visible, textarea hidden). Changes auto-save to localStorage. Boundaries: session persistence across page reloads. Abnormal path: toggling repeatedly without input. Ambiguities: interaction between initial creation state and edit/view mode toggles. R-4: Testable behavior involves deleting a note via (data-testid="delete-note-button"). Normal path: clicking delete removes note element from DOM and entry from localStorage. Boundaries: deleting the last remaining note. Abnormal path: clicking delete on a non-existent or already removed note. Ambiguities: none. R-5: Testable behavior covers loading saved notes from localStorage upon page load. Normal path: renders <div> class="note", tools div with 'Edit' (data-testid="edit-note-button") and 'Delete' (data-testid="delete-note-button"), main div (data-testid="note-main"), and textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"). Notes with content show main div with textarea hidden; empty notes show textarea with main div hidden. Empty localStorage shows no notes. Boundaries: corrupted JSON in localStorage (implied handling via JSON.parse). Ambiguities: exact key name ('notes') is specified.
